name: Aerion
description: Aerion helps authenticated users inspect their project, time tracking, staffing, approval, and analytics data from Claude. Users can find and describe Aerion records, create or update permitted records, submit their own time entries, and perform approval workflows when their Aerion permissions allow it.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Aerion to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Aerion to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://cloud.aerion.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Aerion MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Aerion provides these MCP tools: change_approval_status, create, describe, destroy, find, find_one, list_resources, project_analytics, submit_time_entries, update, user_analytics, and whoami.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Aerion?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Aerion in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Aerion requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Aerion is developed by Aerion. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
